label: rem:c3-s-imq-decay-projection
title: The $\beta$-decay $S = \mathfrak{Q}_\beta/E_0$ realizes candidate (iii): a small sign-flipped $\mathrm{Im}(q)$
html:
Candidate (iii) of the conjecture reads \mathrm{Im}(q) as the non-Hermitian, open-system parameter and notes it "needs a categorical formula for decay widths \Gamma." The bar-odd part S = \mathfrak{Q}_\beta / E_0 of the \beta-decay Q-value supplies exactly such an observable: it is the antisymmetric (\sigma-bar-odd, sinh) companion of the symmetric mass scale, and vanishes at the real substrate — S = 0 when \mathrm{Im}(q) = 0 — so it is the leading response of the framework to a nonzero \mathrm{Im}(q).

Reading S as the first-order response of the figure-eight complex volume \mathrm{Im}\,\mathfrak{V} to a small imaginary part \varepsilon = \mathrm{Im}(q), with the derived meridian map u = 2\log q and leading Neumann–Zagier \mathrm{Im}\,\mathfrak{V} \approx (\sqrt{3}/2)|u|^2\sin(2\arg u), gives S \approx (4\sqrt{3}\,\log q_0 / q_0)\,\varepsilon. Inverting for the required \varepsilon at the two anchors — the input is the measured S, not a fitted formula — yields

  \varepsilon(\mu) \approx +0.015 \;(+1.3\%\ \mathrm{of}\ \mathrm{Re}\,q),
  \qquad
  \varepsilon(\mathfrak{p}) \approx -0.061 \;(-5.5\%),

which is small and sign-flipped between the anchors. Because the two real substrate values q_0 differ by only \sim 10^{-8}, the required \varepsilon cannot be a function of \mathrm{Re}(q_0) at this resolution — it is an independent degree of freedom, as candidate (iii) requires. A real q_0 can never flip the sign of S; a sign-flipped small \mathrm{Im}(q) does so naturally, which is what makes the near-singular sensitivity of the decay coefficient reside in the imaginary (decay) coordinate rather than in \mathrm{Re}(q).

This is a structural identification, not a closure: the map q_0 \mapsto \varepsilon(q_0) is the same open object as the wall phase \arg(u(q_0)), now read as the decay projection's imaginary part. The magnitude |\varepsilon| depends on the choice of derived deformation map u(q); the sign-flip is robust. There is no tension with the canonical convention \mathrm{Im}(q_0) = 0: the masses are the value at \mathrm{Im}(q) = 0, while S is the \partial/\partial\,\mathrm{Im}(q) response — the Im-sensitive measurement the conjecture flagged as pending. The extraction is recorded in qbeta_c3_imq_decay_projection_probe.py.
